# entra-group-trim API reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/documentation.cjs. Do not edit. -->

Advisory content branches selected by current-user Entra membership or ownership.

## EntraGroupTrim

Headless Entra trim beneath a matching SPFx provider with native Graph consent.
Defaults to All/member/all. Control-level classification filters exact-name
candidates before ambiguity; All-ID members avoid metadata and use chunks of
twenty. Owners use every owners page and current /me ID. Errors in any requested
read fail the check even for any/memberOrOwner. Membership is transitive (M365
direct); hidden omissions cannot prove real-world absence. Only current active
content mounts, without wrappers/styles/callbacks; omitted content is empty.
Inflight sharing is provider-local; changed identity masks obsolete grants.
Server authorization remains required.

### Imports

```ts
import { EntraGroupTrim } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
import { EntraGroupTrim } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls';
import { EntraGroupTrim } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls/entra-group-trim';
```

### Use when

- Current-user Entra membership or ownership should select advisory content branches beneath an SPFx provider.

### Avoid when

- Do not use a rendering decision as authorization for server operations.

### Throws

- Missing matching SPFx provider.

### Examples

#### Entra membership branches

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { EntraGroupTrim } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';

<EntraGroupTrim groups={[{ name: 'Engineering' }]} groupType="M365">
  Team content
  <EntraGroupTrim.Fallback>No membership</EntraGroupTrim.Fallback>
</EntraGroupTrim>;
```

### Signatures

```ts
(props: EntraGroupTrimProps): ReactElement<any, string | JSXElementConstructor<any>>
```

Mounts protected content after native Graph current-user membership/ownership
matches selected groups. Validates every selector and resolves names/metadata-required
IDs, applying groupType before named ambiguity. All-ID membership uses checkMemberGroups
in chunks of twenty without metadata; missing and nonmember IDs are indistinguishable. Owners read IDs across every owners page. Errors in any
selected reference/read select ErrorFallback even for any/memberOrOwner.
Requires a matching SPFx provider and sufficient Graph consent. Membership is
transitive (M365 direct); hidden membership omissions cannot prove real-world
absence. Server authorization remains required. Requests share inflight only
per provider; identity changes hide former grants during render.

#### Parameters

- `props`: Selectors, control-level type/relationship/match and structural children.

#### Returns

Active content in a fragment with no DOM wrapper; when omitted, is empty.

#### Throws (2)

- Missing matching SPFx provider.

#### Examples (2)

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { EntraGroupTrim } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
<EntraGroupTrim groups={[{ name: 'Engineering' }]} groupType="M365" relationship="memberOrOwner">
  <section>Team</section>
  <EntraGroupTrim.Loading>Checking</EntraGroupTrim.Loading>
  <EntraGroupTrim.Fallback>No relationship</EntraGroupTrim.Fallback>
  <EntraGroupTrim.ErrorFallback>Unavailable</EntraGroupTrim.ErrorFallback>
</EntraGroupTrim>
```

## EntraGroupRelationship

member (default) uses Graph transitive membership; M365 membership is direct.
owner uses direct owners; memberOrOwner accepts either for each selected group.
Ownership checks fail for synchronized groups and non-M365 mail-enabled or
distribution groups, even when memberOrOwner could otherwise match membership.

## EntraGroupSelector

Exactly one Entra group GUID or exact nonblank display name. groupType belongs
only on EntraGroupTrim, never on individual selectors. Missing/ambiguous names
and mismatched typed IDs are errors; name type filtering precedes ambiguity.

### Imports (6)

```ts
import type { EntraGroupSelector } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
import type { EntraGroupSelector } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls';
import type { EntraGroupSelector } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls/entra-group-trim';
```

### Examples (11)

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { EntraGroupSelector, EntraGroupTrim } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
const group: EntraGroupSelector = { name: 'Engineering' };
<EntraGroupTrim groups={[group]} groupType="M365">Team</EntraGroupTrim>;
```

### Type (5)

```ts
type EntraGroupSelector = | {
      /**
       * Group GUID; compared case-insensitively.
       */ readonly id: string;
      /**
       * Excluded when selecting by ID.
       * Must be omitted or undefined in this branch.
       */ readonly name?: never;
      /**
       * Classification is control-level only.
       * Must be omitted entirely; even groupType: undefined is rejected on a
       * selector. Supply classification on EntraGroupTrim instead.
       */ readonly groupType?: never;
    }
  | {
      /**
       * Exact nonblank display name.
       */ readonly name: string;
      /**
       * Excluded when selecting by name.
       * Must be omitted or undefined in this branch.
       */ readonly id?: never;
      /**
       * Classification is control-level only.
       * Must be omitted entirely; even groupType: undefined is rejected on a
       * selector. Supply classification on EntraGroupTrim instead.
       */ readonly groupType?: never;
    }
```

## EntraGroupTrimBranchProps

Structural Entra-group branch content; no wrapper, style, ref or DOM props.
Changing the active branch or its React marker key remounts its content;
unchanged branch/key rerenders preserve consumer state and child keys.

## EntraGroupTrimProps

Advisory current-user Entra membership/ownership check using the matching SPFx
provider's native Graph client. Graph permissions/consent and hidden membership
restrictions affect observable results; absent hidden membership cannot prove
real-world absence. Unsupported synchronized, Exchange-created mail-enabled
and distribution group owners fail as errors
when metadata identifies that restriction. All ID member checks avoid metadata.

### Imports (8)

```ts
import type { EntraGroupTrimProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
import type { EntraGroupTrimProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls';
import type { EntraGroupTrimProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls/entra-group-trim';
```

### Examples (13)

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { EntraGroupTrim, EntraGroupTrimProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
const props: EntraGroupTrimProps = {
  groups: [{ name: 'Engineering' }], groupType: 'M365', relationship: 'memberOrOwner',
};
<EntraGroupTrim {...props}>Team content</EntraGroupTrim>;
```

### Members (8)

| Member | Type | Requirement | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `EntraGroupTrimProps.children` | `ReactNode` | Optional, readonly | — | Protected content and unique direct family branches. Inactive content never mounts; when omitted, renders empty. ReactNode preserves legacy null input. |
| `EntraGroupTrimProps.groupType` | `EntraGroupType \| undefined` | Optional, readonly | 'All' | All (when omitted), M365 or Security, case-sensitive, applied to every selector. |
| `EntraGroupTrimProps.groups` | `readonly EntraGroupSelector[]` | Required, readonly | — | Required nonempty GUID/name selectors. All selector syntax is validated before requests; names and metadata-required IDs resolve before decision. All-ID member checks cannot distinguish missing groups from nonmembership. |
| `EntraGroupTrimProps.match` | `"all" \| "any" \| undefined` | Optional, readonly | 'all' | all (when omitted) requires every selected group; any requires one, after all reads succeed. |
| `EntraGroupTrimProps.relationship` | `EntraGroupRelationship \| undefined` | Optional, readonly | 'member' | member (when omitted), owner or memberOrOwner; errors in either requested relationship fail the whole check. |

## EntraGroupType

Entra group classification applied to every selector. All (default) adds no
metadata restriction; M365 requires Unified; Security requires securityEnabled
and excludes Unified, including mail-enabled and dynamic security groups.
